import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage

def feats(g, val):
    lab,n=ndimage.label(g==val)
    res=[]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        m=lab==i; c=m.sum()
        ys,xs=np.where(m)
        sub=(m[ys.min():ys.max()+1, xs.min():xs.max()+1]).astype(int)
        h,w=sub.shape
        rot=sub[::-1,::-1]
        lr = (sub==sub[:,::-1]).all()
        tb = (sub==sub[::-1,:]).all()
        r180=(sub==rot).all()
        # holes: zeros in bbox not connected to border
        pad=np.pad(sub,1)
        zl,_=ndimage.label(pad==0)
        border=set(zl[0,:])|set(zl[-1,:])|set(zl[:,0])|set(zl[:,-1])
        holes=len(set(zl.ravel())-border- {0})
        res.append(dict(id=i,cells=int(c),h=h,w=w,dens=round(c/(h*w),3),lr=bool(lr),tb=bool(tb),r180=bool(r180),holes=holes,rows=(int(ys.min()),int(ys.max())),cols=(int(xs.min()),int(xs.max()))))
    return res

def perim(sub):
    p=0
    s=np.pad(sub,1)
    for r in range(1,s.shape[0]-1):
        for c in range(1,s.shape[1]-1):
            if s[r,c]:
                for dr,dc in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
                    if s[r+dr,c+dc]==0: p+=1
    return p

def table(g,val):
    res=[]
    for f in feats(g,val):
        if f['cells']<=2: continue
        h,w=f['h'],f['w']
        sub=None
        res.append({**f,'area':h*w,'per':None})
    # recompute subs with perim
    lab,nn=ndimage.label(g==val)
    out=[]
    for i in range(1,nn+1):
        m=lab==i
        if m.sum()<=2: continue
        ys,xs=np.where(m)
        sub=(m[ys.min():ys.max()+1, xs.min():xs.max()+1]).astype(int)
        h,w=sub.shape
        out.append(dict(id=i,cells=int(m.sum()),h=h,w=w,area=h*w,dens=round(m.sum()/(h*w),3),per=perim(sub)))
    return out

def clusters(g,val):
    lab,nn=ndimage.label(g==val)
    subs=[]
    for i in range(1,nn+1):

        ys,xs=np.where(m)

def overlay_majority(subs, min_votes):
    H=max(s.shape[0] for s in subs); W=max(s.shape[1] for s in subs)
    acc=np.zeros((H,W))
    for s in subs:
        r=(H-s.shape[0])//2; c=(W-s.shape[1])//2
        acc[r:r+s.shape[0], c:c+s.shape[1]] += s
    print(acc)
    return (acc>=min_votes).astype(int)

def rich(sub):
    h,w=sub.shape; c=sub.sum()
    lr=bool((sub==sub[:,::-1]).all()); tb=bool((sub==sub[::-1,:]).all()); r180=bool((sub==sub[::-1,::-1]).all())
    # 2x2 blocks
    b22=sum(1 for r in range(h-1) for cc in range(w-1) if sub[r,cc] and sub[r+1,cc] and sub[r,cc+1] and sub[r+1,cc+1])
    pad=np.pad(sub,1); zl,_=ndimage.label(pad==0)
    border=set(zl[0,:])|set(zl[-1,:])|set(zl[:,0])|set(zl[:,-1])
    holes=len(set(zl.ravel())-border-{0})
    # horizontal runs, vertical runs
    hr=sum(1 for r in range(h) for cc in range(1,w) if sub[r,cc] and (cc==0 or not sub[r,cc-1]) )
    vr=sum(1 for cc in range(w) for r in range(1,h) if sub[r,cc] and (r==0 or not sub[r-1,cc]))
    # adjacency diag count
    diag=sum(1 for r in range(h-1) for cc in range(w-1) if sub[r,cc] and sub[r+1,cc+1])
    diag+=sum(1 for r in range(h-1) for cc in range(1,w) if sub[r,cc] and sub[r+1,cc-1])
    # 4-conn vs 8-conn components of the shape itself
    _,n8=ndimage.label(sub, structure=np.ones((3,3)))
    return dict(cells=int(c),h=h,w=w,area=h*w,dens=c/(h*w),per=perim(sub),lr=lr,tb=tb,r180=r180,
                b22=b22,holes=holes,hr=hr,vr=vr,diag=diag,per_per_cell=perim(sub)/c)

def show(S,ans):
    for s in S:
        if s['id']==ans: mark='ANS'
        else: mark=''
        print(mark, {k:(round(v,3) if isinstance(v,float) else v) for k,v in s.items()})

def biglist(g,val):
    lab,nn=ndimage.label(g==val)
    res=[]
    for i in range(1,nn+1):
        m=lab==i
        if m.sum()<3: continue
        ys,xs=np.where(m)
        sub=(m[ys.min():ys.max()+1, xs.min():xs.max()+1]).astype(int)
        res.append({'id':i, **rich(sub)})
    return res

# adjacency (8-conn) of dots to each big shape
import scipy.ndimage as ndi
def dotadj(g,v):
    lab,nn=ndimage.label(g==v)
    bigs={i:None for i in range(1,nn+1) if (lab==i).sum()>=3}
    st=np.ones((3,3),bool)
    dots=[]
    for i in range(1,nn+1):
        m=lab==i
        if m.sum()<=2:
            ys,xs=np.where(m); dots.append(list(zip(ys.tolist(),xs.tolist())))
    for b in bigs:
        mb=lab==b
        dil=ndi.binary_dilation(mb,st)
        touch=[d for d in dots if all(dil[p] for p in d)]
        if touch: print(' shape',b,'cells',(mb).sum(),'touching dots:',touch)

def holes(sub):
    bg=~(sub>0)
    labh,nh=ndimage.label(bg)
    border=set(labh[0,:]) | set(labh[-1,:]) | set(labh[:,0]) | set(labh[:,-1])
    return sum(1 for i in range(1,nh+1) if i not in border)

def syms(sub):
    s={}
    s['lr']=np.array_equal(sub,sub[:,::-1])
    s['tb']=np.array_equal(sub,sub[::-1,:])
    s['rot180']=np.array_equal(sub,sub[::-1,::-1])
    s['anti']=np.array_equal(sub,np.fliplr(sub).T[::-1,::-1].T) if False else np.array_equal(sub[::-1,::-1].T,sub) # check both diag types
    s['diag']=np.array_equal(sub.T,sub)
    return s

for k,(g,v) in [('d1',(inp2,1)),('d2',(D2,2)),('d3',(D3,3))]:
    labx,nnx=ndimage.label(g==v)
    print('===',k)
    for i in range(1,nnx+1):
        m=labx==i
        if m.sum()<3: continue
        ys,xs=np.where(m)
        sub=m[ys.min():ys.max()+1,xs.min():xs.max()+1].astype(int)
        print(' shape',i,'cells',int(m.sum()),'bbox',sub.shape,'at rows',ys.min(),'-',ys.max(),'cols',xs.min(),'-',xs.max(),
              'holes',holes(sub),syms(sub))

def objects8(g,v):
    lab,nn=ndimage.label(g==v,structure=np.ones((3,3)))
    objs=[]
    for i in range(1,nn+1):
        m=lab==i
        ys,xs=np.where(m)
        sub=m[ys.min():ys.max()+1,xs.min():xs.max()+1].astype(int)
        objs.append(dict(cells=int(m.sum()),r0=int(ys.min()),r1=int(ys.max()),c0=int(xs.min()),c1=int(xs.max()),sub=sub))
    return objs

def transforms(sub):
    a=sub
    for t in ['id','lr','tb','180','tr','tl','r90','r270']:
        if t=='id': b=a
        elif t=='lr': b=a[:,::-1]
        elif t=='tb': b=a[::-1,:]
        elif t=='180': b=a[::-1,::-1]
        elif t=='tr': b=a.T[::-1]   # transpose+flip
        elif t=='tl': b=a.T
        elif t=='r90': b=a[:,::-1].T
        elif t=='r270': b=a.T[:,::-1]

def feats(cs,g,v):
    ys=cs[:,0]-cs[:,0].min(); xs=cs[:,1]-cs[:,1].min()
    h,w=ys.max()+1,xs.max()+1
    sub=np.zeros((h,w),bool); sub[ys,xs]=True
    # 4-conn main
    st4=ndi.generate_binary_structure(2,1)
    lab,nn=ndi.label(sub,structure=st4)
    sizes=sorted([int((lab==i).sum()) for i in range(1,nn+1)],reverse=True)
    main=sizes[0] if sizes else 0
    ndots=len(cs)-sum(sizes[:1])  # approx: cells outside main comp
    nholes=int((~sub[1:-1,1:-1]).sum())
    # degree stats on 4-conn full cells
    degs=[]
    for y,x in zip(ys,xs):
        d=sum(((y+dy,x+dx) in set(zip(ys.tolist(),xs.tolist()))) for dy,dx in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)])
        degs.append(d)
    degs=np.array(degs)
    # diagonal-only attachment cells
    S=set(zip(ys.tolist(),xs.tolist()))
    diagonly=sum(1 for y,x in S if not any((y+dy,x+dx) in S for dy,dx in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]) and any((y+dy,x+dx) in S for dy,dx in [(1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)]))
    # symmetry of the 8-comp sub
    syms_lr=np.array_equal(sub,sub[:,::-1]); syms_tb=np.array_equal(sub,sub[::-1])
    syms_180=np.array_equal(sub,sub[::-1,::-1])
    return dict(n=len(cs),main=main,ndots=len(cs)-main,h=h,w=w,area=h*w,dens=len(cs)/(h*w),
        ndeg1=int((degs==1).sum()),ndeg4=int((degs==4).sum()),maxdeg=int(degs.max()),
        diagonly=diagonly,lr=bool(syms_lr),tb=bool(syms_tb),r180=bool(syms_180),
        r0=int(cs[:,0].min()),c0=int(cs[:,1].min()),r1=int(cs[:,0].max()),c1=int(cs[:,1].max()),
        ncomp4=len(sizes))
